summary.text: Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform is a Heavenly Court time path Immortal Gu House.

claims.text: Speaking with Duke Long, Fairy Zi Wei already keeps Present and Past Pavilion in the River of Time and names Eternal Yacht as almost completed. She still plans to construct Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and Shark Flow Lever, so four time path Immortal Gu Houses can stop Fang Yuan from taking Red Lotus true inheritance.

After Eternal Yacht’s construction fails, Fairy Zi Wei tells Duke Long that Present and Past Pavilion remains in the River of Time, and that she still plans to construct Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Shark Flow Lever, and Moment Stage, so five time path Immortal Gu Houses can keep Fang Yuan from Red Lotus true inheritances even if Heavenly Court cannot find them.

When three Immortal Gu Houses chase Fang Yuan in the River of Time, the middle house is elegant and grand, with an orange roof that resembles cranes with their wings spread out, and it radiates three layers of autumn light. Fang Yuan counts three rank seven Immortal Gu Houses in that chase. In the sudden spring river segment, Eternal Yacht and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform are hit first and pushed up. Later Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform fall far behind, and only Eternal Yacht can still catch him.

Feng Jiu Ge stays in Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform during a later River of Time contest, while Xing Ye Wang stands on Shark Flow Lever. Fang Yuan, in immemorial year monkey form, pounces toward the platform because Feng Jiu Ge is there. The house bursts out with dazzling light and stops him as if he had crashed into a metal wall. His huge fists still shake it, send rubble flying, and push it back. Gu Immortals inside, at rank seven, report that the northern corner is destroyed, that three layers of autumn light shields have been broken with only one left, and that Immortal Gu Autumn Light has cracks. The outside is shattered, but the foundation is unaffected and only a large number of mortal Gu are lost. Those rank seven Gu Immortals try to repair it rapidly. Feng Jiu Ge does not fight in person, because sound path work cannot match the River of Time and only the time path house can resist Fang Yuan there.

Fang Yuan rains punches on the platform like a flurry of meteors and forces it to retreat continuously. He then stomps it into the river, creating a huge wave, and shoots toward the stone lotus island. Feng Jiu Ge later arrives in Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, and the two sides clash until the situation is in a deadlock.

Summer fan then sends Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and Shark Flow Lever into a tornado outside the river suppression lotus sealing formation. Both houses reenter, erupt with powerful attacks on Bing Sai Chuan’s light shield, and help suppress Fang Yuan and Longevity Heaven.

After the stone lotus island is destroyed, Feng Jiu Ge returns to Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform. Heavenly Court’s remaining time path Immortal Gu Houses are only rank seven. The three houses that still stand, including this platform, retreat through a tributary after Present and Past Pavilion stays behind and is destroyed.

When Myriad Year Flying Warship meets a river suppression lotus sealing formation trap, Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform appears with Shark Flow Lever. Heavenly Court is still reconstructing Present and Past Pavilion and Eternal Yacht, while these two houses’ constructions had begun long ago, were completed recently, and are sent into this battle. The platform blocks Fang Yuan’s retreat while Gu Liu Ru stalls the warship, and both houses use killer moves when he charges through.

A rank seven Gu Immortal inside the platform argues that they must destroy Myriad Year Flying Warship instead of fighting the year beast tide. Heavenly Court’s two time path Immortal Gu Houses are both rank seven and can match rank eight battle strength against most year beasts. Gu Liu Ru and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform cannot harm the warship’s defense, and are forced to block Fang Yuan’s attacks while defending retreating Gu Immortals from the large formation, until they cannot cope with attacks from all directions. Fang Yuan clings the warship onto Shark Flow Lever or Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform so the year beasts’ rush also hits those houses. After Shark Flow Lever is destroyed, Gu Liu Ru takes Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and leaves the battlefield rapidly.

Myriad Year Flying Warship storms the platform with daybreak flying swords. Central Continent Gu Immortals inside tell Gu Liu Ru to leave first. Fairy Zi Wei has already ordered the platform to block the warship while he escapes. He jumps out and dives into the River of Time. The platform blocks Fang Yuan without regard for itself, long enough that Gu Liu Ru enters a tributary and reaches the outside world. The house is already an exhausted force. Under violent repeated collisions it completely breaks into pieces, and over ten Gu Immortals fall into the river.

When five Immortal Gu Houses chase Myriad Year Flying Warship, Bai Ning Bing and the rest note that Heavenly Court also has Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Shark Flow Lever, and a mysterious Immortal Gu House besides the rebuilt Present and Past Pavilion and Eternal Yacht.

Four Immortal Gu Houses fly above the River of Time toward a stone lotus island. Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform is again elegant and grand, with the orange crane-wing roof and three layers of autumn light. Gu Liu Ru orders Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform to patrol the surroundings and report anything that shows up, while he leads Moment Stage, Feng Jiu Ge leads Present and Past Pavilion, and Eternal Yacht moves to a tributary entrance for reinforcements.

When Myriad Year Flying Warship appears, the two patrolling houses change direction to obstruct it. Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform arrives first and fights the warship, splashing the river with impacts. Daybreak sword flying swords attack the platform. It shines with bright orange light and the silver swords weaken continuously. After Moment Stage collides with the warship, Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform stall the warship’s advance.

Among Moment Stage, Present and Past Pavilion, Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Eternal Yacht, Shark Flow Lever, and Sun and Moon Temple, Heavenly Court surrounds the warship. When Heavenly Court tries to leave, daybreak swords shoot toward Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and Shark Flow Lever.

After Fang Yuan dismantles six Immortal Gu Houses from that River of Time battle, the Early Autumn, Mid Autumn, and Late Autumn of Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform are among the Immortal Gu he keeps. Those three sit in the same recovered haul as Suppression, Permanence, Instant, and others. Across that whole haul, most are rank seven, and some are rank eight.

When Fang Yuan constructs Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool, he builds a year essence sub-pool to lead a tributary of the River of Time into the square pool, and arranges three rank eight time path Immortal Gu from Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform: Early Autumn, Mid Autumn, and Late Autumn. Those three sit among the pool’s top supplementary Immortal Gu.
